text:
Wayne County districts enrolled 10,593 Asian students in 2024-25
Wayne County districts enrolled 10,593 Asian students in the 2024-25 school year, an increase of 1.8% from the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
A total of 258,496 students were enrolled in Wayne County in the 2024-25 school year. Asian students made up 4.1% of the student population, the fourth-most represented ethnicity in county districts.
Among the county’s 130 districts, Plymouth-Canton Community Schools had the largest Asian enrollment in the 2024-25 school year, with 2,440 students.
The main offices of the districts mentioned are located in cities associated with Wayne County.
In the 2025-26 school year, over 1.41 million students were enrolled in Michigan schools, a decline of about 5.3% from the nearly 1.45 million recorded before the pandemic in the 2019-20 school year. White student enrollment registered the largest drop, falling about 5.8%.
